notes.title: DELAY (feat. covid-19)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/0988c4832151e87163198949b837279f3dde543e.png[/img]
COVID-19 has spread in our office.
In my case, I was inevitably hospitalized because of a chronic disease.
I was discharged from the hospital after a few days of quarantine, but my condition is still not returning due to COVID-19.
This inevitably pushed back the previously promised update date.
I'm sorry to tell you this news to those who were waiting for the new character.

[h1]The new update date is March 17.[/h1]

Ps. Many people ask me about my health. For those people, I'd like to briefly talk about my physical condition.
Since I got sick three years ago, making ISEKAI QUEST, I've still been in bad shape. I can't eat most of the food, and I go out about three times a year. I was 181cm tall and 55kg right before I got COVID-19.
So I'm literally putting all my energy into making games. I feel like I'm getting better little by little, but I can say that normal life is impossible.



Once again, I'm sorry for the delay in the release of the game. We'll come back with the best game possible.

notes.title: 08/09/2021 Update!
notes.content:
It's been a while,
We're really happy to announce a new update!


- The H scene of Eris has been reworked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/1546522cd1e2536cd32dd83ee1404c67cbe81cd0.png[/img]

There were constant askings, and I think this is the answer!



- A New character : Betty

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/005ac068293777190ecaebe34a00af52f15e4a20.png[/img]

Let's do some orc hunt with Betty! Drink messed potions and let's find out what is true and not.



- About remaining updates

We originally planned ISEKAI QUEST with 6 characters total at first.
So any additional characters would deliver in the DLC, that was the plan.

But after a long discussion,
we decided to deliver 2 more characters, with Free updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/3274ab2c218ffc91d550d1725588f73449c6f81e.png[/img]


Sorry that can not tell the specific schedule at the moment,
We were a very small team with part-time developers lately
But we could keep updating and developing thanks to your supports!

We wish you enjoy this update.
Thank you!

notes.title: About the reason for the late update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/374c68e1f917fb003147d08e6ddb87a3c8fe759b.png[/img]
Greetings. I'm Hamong from the Ginkgo Studio

I'm pleased to meet you people and I'm sorry
perhaps some of you might know already, I have been sick and unable to keep my life going recently for a couple of months
although it's not cured yet, I guess it's possible to draw my paintings again

I don't know where to start this conversation from though
first of all, about my illness
I have been unhealthy for over a year. while I was on my project, I had a stomach ulcer and reflux esophagitis, but I kept working
eventually I lost weight(20kg) and the illness was getting worse so I was totally unable to keep on anymore. even difficult to talk and just to seat. I was frightened, to tell the truth, I would like to apologize for this
hopefully it's a bit better now so I can continue the work again, although it's not completely cured yet.

And next, I would like to talk about the next project
'Isekai Quest' aside, we were planning to program and publish the 'Spooky Milk Life' project
the main plan was, to hire a programmer to proceed. but he just absconded with the advanced payment, which ruined our first plan. the best we could decide at this moment is to send R35(who is our programmer) to 'Spooky Milk Life' programming.
I would like to apologize for this poor management.

This is what happened during the last winter and this spring. I firmly regret not letting you know this. please forgive our mistakes from inexperience
but our goal is clear. I'm going to finish the Isekai Quest and publish Spooky Milk Life.

I would be very grateful if you could wait for this.

There will be an update around the end of June which will be notified again. and I hope you look forward to our new project Spooky Milk Life

[url=https://www.patreon.com/Spooky_Milk_Life]
Spooky Milk Life
[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37950691/ce283d6254c4f27e8044a08eba33ad1b14831a36.png[/img]


I would like to say thank you for having me and our game.

In short
1.The illustrator has been ill and was unable to work.
2.New programmer absconded with advanced payment.
3.But we are going to finish the game no matter the time it will take.
